name: Future Fisheries Improvement Program
summary: Twice-yearly Montana grants for on-the-ground restoration of rivers, streams and lakes to improve wild fish habitat, such as fish passage, stream channel and riparian work, with landowner approval.

status.quote: The Summer 2026 Future Fisheries Improvement Program grant application deadline is May 15, 2026.

deadline.quote: The Summer 2026 Future Fisheries Improvement Program grant application deadline is May 15, 2026.

calls.label: Winter funding cycle
calls.recurring: Applications are due on 15 November each year (winter cycle) and 15 May (summer cycle).

status.quote: The Future Fisheries Improvement Program grant applications are due May 15 (summer cycle) and November 15 (winter cycle) of each year.

recurring.quote: The Future Fisheries Improvement Program grant applications are due May 15 (summer cycle) and November 15 (winter cycle) of each year.

applicant_types.quote: Any entity with a good on-the-ground project that benefits wild fish can apply for funding through the Future Fisheries Improvement Program, including (but is not limited to) landowners, anglers, civic groups, conservation districts, or governmental agencies.

geography.quote: To be eligible, projects must be completed within the state of Montana.

access.quote: Applications must be completed in entirety and signed by the applicant.

window.quote: The Future Fisheries Improvement has a summer and winter funding cycle each year.
